auditScope: Inter-clip scale, source-cell support placement, right-facing direction and macro continuity of the four selected active boards only.

scaleReview.landmark: longitudinal chord of the smooth dorsal cranial dome, from the posterior dome apex at the nuchal junction to the rostral tip
scaleReview.decision: A calibrated sourceScaleByClip should be supplied before normalization. Move is consistently about 9.2 percent smaller than idle on the rigid dome landmark and is the material correction. Attack and death are already within roughly two percent; their measured factors are low-confidence fine alignment within the manual endpoint uncertainty and must be confirmed in atlas coordinates.

supportReview.measurementMeaning: Lowest conservative foreground clue in each nominal source cell. This is source-placement evidence, not an authored or accepted physical foot root.
supportReview.decision: Per-frame physical-root anchors are mandatory. Scale calibration alone cannot remove the 24 to 65.5 pixel upward jump between source rows, especially in attack and death.

visualReview.direction: All 32 active poses retain a right-facing head and action direction. No orientation swap was observed.
visualReview.identity: The low quadrupedal silhouette, smooth eyeless dome, ribbed shell, low dorsal plates, two forelimbs, two hind limbs and complete bladed tail remain recognizable across clips. No macro identity swap was observed.
visualReview.idle: Eight subtle readiness and breathing variations remain close enough for a loop; row placement changes by 24 pixels and still requires anchoring.
visualReview.move: Alternating compression and extension read as a low quadrupedal run. Tail and dome stay coherent; frame 3 to 4 source placement rises by 49 pixels.
visualReview.attack: Anticipation, lunge, airborne extension and recovery form a readable macro arc. Frames 2 to 5 retain the documented cell-ownership blocker and the row transition rises by 65.5 pixels.
visualReview.death: Stagger, drop, roll and final prone settlement are irreversible with no return to standing. The row transition rises by 64 pixels and must be root-corrected before timing review.

requiredFollowUp: Merge the measured sourceScaleByClip only through the reviewed calibration registry; never resize or overwrite the source PNGs.
Use the recorded safe cell-reassignment path for attack before extraction and keep its ownership evidence.
Normalize with explicit per-frame physical-root anchors.
Render atlas contacts and GIFs, then re-measure the dome in atlas coordinates and verify support continuity, attack ownership and loop seams.
